Hi Anne —

Thanks for the clear list. Answers below with references to artifacts attached. Short version: our hosted API targets are designed for sub-15 minute cross-region warm failover for customer-facing requests; dedicated customers can opt into <5 minute warm standby with reserved capacity. Details: 

• RTO / RPO
  - Hosted API (standard): RTO = 15 minutes for request-serving recovery assuming warm-standby in secondary region; RPO = 1 hour for stateful control-plane metadata (user configs), embeddings and model artifacts are immutable and re-provisioned from artifact store (RPO = 0 for model artifacts).
  - Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity): configurable. Default committed profile: RTO = 5 minutes with hot-standby allocation; RPO = 15 minutes for metadata.
  - For critical tenants (enterprise SLA): we publish per-deal RTO/RPO in the Dedicated contract appendix.

• Failover time (us-east -> us-west)
  - Expected time-to-first-request: 10–15 minutes for Hosted (route propagation + KV cache rebuild). With pre-warmed instances and active replication (enterprise config) we measure 3–5 minutes. See attached playbook excerpt (redwood_bcdr_playbook_v2.pdf) and recent tabletop results.

• Backup cadence & retention
  - Control-plane metadata snapshots: taken every 30 minutes, retained 30 days. (sig-response-matrix.xlsx, sheet: Backups)
  - Persistent datastore (customer state where applicable): incremental snapshots every 4 hours, full nightly snapshot; retention default 90 days (longer retention as contract option).
  - Artifact store (models/weights): immutable object storage with versioning; retention indefinite per model version.

• Restore testing cadence & evidence
  - Restore drills: quarterly restore tests for hosted infra, monthly failover tabletop for Dedicated customers with SLAs. Last full restore test: 2024-10-03 — successful full restore in 12m 40s (log excerpt in sig-response-matrix.xlsx).

• Runbook & escalation
  - Executive summary included in redwood_bcdr_playbook_v2.pdf (section 2.1). On-call escalation: Primary SRE on-call (24/7) + Customer Escalation lead. For NovaHealth we can provide direct escalation path: SRE Pager + enterprise escalation cell.

Artifacts we are providing with this message: redwood_bcdr_playbook_v2.pdf (playbook excerpt), snapshot-policy-diagram.png (replication topology), sig-response-matrix.xlsx (answers tied to SIG IDs + test logs). If you need auditor-specific exports (e.g., anonymized restore logs), we can produce a packaged evidence bundle with narrow-scope logs and a redaction summary.

If helpful I can put together a 30-minute walkthrough with SRE and Product to walk through the playbook and the restore logs. Available windows tomorrow 10–12 or Thursday 14–16 ET.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Architect — Security & Compliance
